confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Finnish and Nordic price levels, not live listings. Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, meals) are moderately reliable. Accommodation is less certain because Rovaniemi rates swing a lot with season and events, and July is a high-demand summer period. Cocktail and wine were set from the local beer relationship (cocktail about 2x beer, wine glass about 1.5x beer) because direct knowledge is weak. EUR-to-USD was assumed near 1.15 USD per EUR. The FX rate was taken from search-result summaries that attribute it to the RBA overview page; I did not open the RBA page or F11 table directly, so confirm it there.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: mid-sized Finnish tourist and university towns such as Oulu, adjusted upward for Rovaniemi's Arctic-tourism pricing and summer accommodation demand, and cross-checked against Nordic price levels generally.
